entries.name: copilot
entries.login_message: GitHub Copilot CLI signs in with the OAuth device code flow. Open the URL it prints in a browser on your host, sign in to GitHub, and enter the code it shows. The credentials stay in the home volume of this sandbox.

entries.name: claude
entries.login_message: Claude Code signs in through a browser. The subscription workflow uses a Claude subscription; the console workflow uses Anthropic Console with API usage billing. Open the URL it prints in a browser on your host, sign in, and paste the code shown there back into this terminal. The credentials stay in the home volume of this sandbox.

entries.name: codex
entries.login_message: Codex CLI signs in with the workflow you chose. The chatgpt workflow uses the OAuth device code flow: open the URL it prints in a browser on your host, sign in with your ChatGPT account, and enter the code it shows. The api-key workflow reads an OpenAI API key from standard input. The credentials stay in the home volume of this sandbox.

entries.name: opencode
entries.login_message: OpenCode asks for a provider and then for that provider's API key or sign-in. It stores the credentials in ~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json in the home volume of this sandbox.
